official.application_cycle: Rolling submissions via elane; five FWF Scientific Board approval meetings per year
official.status_note: The official page lists submissions as rolling: applications can be submitted at any time through the online application portal elane, with five approval meetings per year.
benefits: Principal investigator's salary (current senior postdoc rate) for the 36-month project
Project-specific costs from EUR 45,000 (flat rate) to EUR 75,000 (upon request, if justifiable)
A mentor to support the principal investigator's scientific and professional development
Child allowance for women employed full time, up to the child's third birthday
Networking activities, annual workshops and visibility measures for women involved in ESPRIT projects
eligibility: Highly qualified postdoc-level researchers of all disciplines in the early stages of their scientific career
The applicant must have the academic qualifications needed to lead the proposed research project
Completed doctoral degree awarded no more than 5 years prior to the time of application
A mentor to support the principal investigator's scientific and professional development
Project to be carried out at an Austrian research institution with the necessary infrastructure
requirements: Application must be submitted with an Austrian research institution (PROFI mode): in elane select 'Application PROFI', then the funding category 'ESP - ESPRIT Program'
A professional development and mentoring plan is mandatory and factors into the review process
For approved projects, the mentor's support declaration (Unterstuetzungserklaerung Mentor:in) is required
No cost breakdown is required for the EUR 45,000 lump sum; applying for up to EUR 75,000 requires a cost breakdown of the entire amount requested with justification
While an ESPRIT application is pending, no parallel application to ESPRIT, Erwin Schroedinger, Elise Richter or Elise Richter PEEK may be submitted
Applications may be submitted from abroad: the territoriality principle does not apply to ESPRIT, but an Austrian mentor and an Austrian host research institution are still required
documents: Project description and annexes uploaded in full in elane
Template publication record of the principal investigator
Scientific disciplines / Code Statistics Austria classification document
Information on and form for accounting for career breaks, if applicable
selection_criteria: Decided by the Scientific Board based on an international review process
In the case of equal qualifications and equal quality of proposals, women are given priority in the selection process
Half of the projects are awarded to women; a detailed professional development and mentoring plan is part of the reviewed application
coverage: Principal investigator's salary at the current senior postdoc rate (2026 standard rate: EUR 97,380 per year / EUR 5,499.10 per month, gross including the employer's contribution)
Project-specific costs of EUR 45,000 as a flat rate, or up to EUR 75,000 with justification, over the 36-month funding period
application_method: Submit the application online through the elane portal in PROFI mode
In elane, first select the type of funding 'Application PROFI' (not 'Application ad personam'), then the funding category 'ESP - ESPRIT Program'
Submissions are rolling; five FWF approval meetings are held per year
official.application_route: Rolling online submission through the elane portal in PROFI mode, secured with an Austrian mentor and an Austrian host research institution.
official.study_mode: Full-time employment of the principal investigator at the host institution
official.citizenship_residency: No nationality or residency rule is published; the territoriality principle does not apply to ESPRIT, so applications may be submitted from abroad.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - researchers applying from abroad are eligible, provided they secure an Austrian mentor and an Austrian host research institution in advance.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Open to researchers of all disciplines, including arts-based research.
official.research_requirement: The applicant leads an independent research project as principal investigator; the project description and the professional development and mentoring plan form part of the application that is internationally reviewed.
official.description: The FWF describes ESPRIT (Early-Stage Program: Research - Innovation - Training) as a funding programme intended to improve the skills and support the professional development of researchers from all disciplines early in their research careers by giving them the opportunity to lead an independent research project.
official.program_type: Career development grant for early-career postdocs (principal investigator project)

not_confirmed: travel coverage (not separately published; only the flat-rate project costs are itemised)
English language test requirement (none is published)
exact submission date of the next approval meeting (only the rolling route and five meetings per year are published)
verification.notes: The FWF ESPRIT programme page (including its programme-specific FAQ) and the FWF 2026 personnel costs page were read in full on 2026-10-10. Funding period (36 months), the EUR 45,000 flat rate up to EUR 75,000 on justified request, the senior postdoc salary basis, rolling elane submission in PROFI mode, and the five yearly approval meetings are published verbatim.

applicant_utility.summary: ESPRIT is a job as much as a grant: the FWF employs you at the host institution for 36 months at the senior postdoc rate (EUR 97,380 per year in 2026, gross) and layers a project budget of at least EUR 45,000 on top. The two gating items are people, not paperwork - you need an Austrian mentor who signs a support declaration and mentoring plan, and an Austrian host institution willing to submit the application in PROFI mode. Because submissions are rolling with five board meetings a year, your start date depends on which meeting your file lands at, so apply as soon as your documents are complete rather than waiting.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Postdocs inside the five-year window after their doctorate, in any discipline, who have a credible Austrian mentor and host institution and want a funded PI project without applying from within Austria.
application_readiness_checklist: Agree the mentoring relationship first: the mentor's support declaration is only needed for approved projects, but the professional development and mentoring plan must be submitted with the application and is reviewed

Check your doctoral certificate date against the five-year rule; if the doctorate will be completed within the roughly 4 to 6 month processing time you may apply, but the project cannot start before the certificate is submitted
With two or more subject profiles, confirm which doctorate counts - the subject-specific degree counts, as for the START programme
Prepare the template publication record, the Statistics Austria scientific disciplines code and the ESPRIT checklist before opening elane, since the file must be uploaded in full
If you want the higher budget up to EUR 75,000, draft the cost breakdown and justification for the whole amount from the start
common_rejection_risks: No mentor named, or a mentor letter drafted as an afterthought - the plan must be specific enough to be reviewed
Applying while another ESPRIT, Erwin Schroedinger, Elise Richter or Elise Richter PEEK application is pending; the programmes cannot run in parallel
Choosing the wrong elane route (Application ad personam instead of Application PROFI), so the ESPRIT category never appears in the drop-down
Assuming you must already be in Austria - you may apply from abroad, but without an Austrian host and mentor the application cannot be submitted
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The flat-rate project costs of EUR 45,000 to EUR 75,000 are the ceiling for project spending; anything the project genuinely needs beyond them (your own living setup, relocation costs beyond the salary) has to be covered by you or the host institution.
document_audit: Career breaks must be documented with the FWF information sheet and form, otherwise review may not account for them
Publication lists must use the FWF template publication record - free-format CV publication lists are not what reviewers want
The mentor's support declaration is only required for approved projects, so do not let an approved grant stall for a missing document at approval stage
Mentors are unpaid by design; do not write them into the budget
alerts: The FWF states that half of ESPRIT funds go to women, and women are given priority when qualifications and proposal quality are equal
Women employed full time receive a child allowance up to the child's third birthday - it applies automatically and must not be financed from project funds
Lise Meitner or Hertha Firnberg principal investigators are not automatically excluded, but the five-year doctorate rule still applies
The 2026 salary rate (senior postdoc EUR 97,380 per year) is the benchmark for budgeting your own salary within the project
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Secure mentor and host, assemble the project description, mentoring plan and templates, submit in elane under 'Application PROFI' with category 'ESP - ESPRIT Program', and wait for the next of the five annual approval meetings.
